# Austin Roofing

> Austin Roofing is an Austin, TX roofing company for roof repair, roof replacement, hail and wind storm damage, commercial and multi-family roofing across Central Texas. Free inspections and quotes. Phone: +1 (956) 465-6045. Email: info@austinsroofing.com. 24/7 emergency service.

## Services
- [Austin Roof Repair](https://austinsroofing.com/services/roof-repair/): Leaks, missing shingles, failed flashing and storm wear repaired fast — with photos of every problem before we fix it.
- [Austin Roof Replacement](https://austinsroofing.com/services/roof-replacement/): Full tear-off and new roof systems built for Central Texas heat and hail, usually completed in one to two days.
- [Austin Roof Installation](https://austinsroofing.com/services/roof-installation/): New-construction and additions roofed to code with matched underlayment, ventilation and flashing details.
- [Austin Residential Roofing](https://austinsroofing.com/services/residential-roofing/): Shingle, metal and composition roofs for Austin homeowners — repair, replacement, ventilation and gutters.
- [Austin Composition Shingle Roofing](https://austinsroofing.com/services/shingle-roofing/): Architectural, impact-resistant (Class 4) and designer composition shingles installed to manufacturer spec.
- [Austin Metal Roofing](https://austinsroofing.com/services/metal-roofing/): Standing seam, exposed-fastener and stone-coated steel roofs that shrug off Texas sun and last 40+ years.
- [Austin Commercial Roofing](https://austinsroofing.com/services/commercial-roofing/): TPO, EPDM, modified bitumen, built-up and metal systems — repair, replacement and maintenance plans.
- [Austin Commercial Roof Coatings](https://austinsroofing.com/services/commercial-roof-coatings/): Silicone, acrylic and polyurethane coatings that seal leaks and cut cooling loads without a tear-off.
- [Austin Multi-Family Roofing](https://austinsroofing.com/services/multifamily-roofing/): Apartments, townhomes, condos and HOA communities roofed on a phased schedule with minimal resident disruption.
- [Austin Roof Restoration](https://austinsroofing.com/services/roof-restoration/): Repair, reinforce and re-seal a roof that still has good bones — years of extra life for a fraction of replacement.
- [Austin Hail Damage Roof Repair](https://austinsroofing.com/services/hail-damage-repair/): Bruised shingles, granule loss and dented metal found, photographed and documented for your insurer.
- [Austin Wind Damage Roof Repair](https://austinsroofing.com/services/wind-damage-repair/): Lifted tabs, creased shingles, blown-off ridge caps and torn flashing secured before the next rain.
- [Austin Emergency Roof Repair](https://austinsroofing.com/services/emergency-roof-repair/): 24/7 tarping and leak control after storms, fallen limbs or sudden leaks — call and talk to a roofer.
- [Austin Roof Insurance Claim Help](https://austinsroofing.com/services/roof-insurance-claims/): Photo-documented damage reports and adjuster meetings so your hail or wind claim reflects the real damage.
- [Austin Roof Inspection](https://austinsroofing.com/services/roof-inspection/): Free, photo-documented inspections for storms, home sales, insurance renewals and aging roofs.

## Free Roofing Tools
- [Roof Replacement Cost Calculator](https://austinsroofing.com/roofing-tools/roof-cost-calculator/): Estimate a planning range for a new roof in the Austin area by size, pitch, material and tear-off.
- [Roofing Square & Shingle Bundle Calculator](https://austinsroofing.com/roofing-tools/roofing-square-calculator/): Turn your home’s footprint and pitch into roofing squares, shingle bundles, underlayment rolls and ridge cap.
- [Roof Pitch Calculator](https://austinsroofing.com/roofing-tools/roof-pitch-calculator/): Enter rise and run to get pitch, angle and the area multiplier — with a live roof diagram.
- [Repair or Replace? Roof Quiz](https://austinsroofing.com/roofing-tools/repair-or-replace-quiz/): Seven quick questions that tell you whether your roof probably needs a repair, a closer look or a replacement.
- [Hail Size & Roof Damage Checker](https://austinsroofing.com/roofing-tools/hail-damage-checker/): Pick the hail size you saw and your roof type to see the damage it typically causes and what to do next.
- [Roof Lifespan Calculator](https://austinsroofing.com/roofing-tools/roof-lifespan-calculator/): See how many years your roof likely has left in Central Texas heat, based on material, age and attic ventilation.

## Blog
- [Roofing Underlayment Material Types: A Complete Guide](https://austinsroofing.com/blog/roofing-underlayment-material-types/): Felt, synthetic or self-adhered? Every type of roof underlayment and roofing paper compared side by side, with what Austin roofers actually install.
- [Cost of Asphalt Shingles Per Square: A Complete Pricing Guide](https://austinsroofing.com/blog/cost-of-asphalt-shingles-per-square/): Shingle prices per square for 3-tab, dimensional and premium asphalt shingles, plus what drives the installed price on an Austin roof.
- [Insurance Coverage for Storm-Damaged Roofs](https://austinsroofing.com/blog/insurance-coverage-for-storm-damaged-roofs/): What your policy covers after hail or wind, how ACV and replacement-cost policies differ, and how to file a roof claim in Austin without leaving money behind.
- [Architectural Shingle vs Asphalt Shingles](https://austinsroofing.com/blog/architectural-shingle-vs-asphalt-shingles/): Both are asphalt shingles — but thickness, wind rating, lifespan and price per square are very different. Here is how they compare.
- [Roof Replacement Permit Requirements: Homeowners Need to Know](https://austinsroofing.com/blog/roof-replacement-permit-requirements/): When a re-roof needs a permit, who is responsible for pulling it, what inspectors check and what Austin-area homeowners should ask their roofer.
- [Residential Metal Roofing Lifespan: What Impacts Their Durability](https://austinsroofing.com/blog/residential-metal-roofing-lifespan/): Steel, aluminum, standing seam or stone-coated: how long each metal roof lasts and the installation details that decide it.
- [How Much Does It Cost to Replace a Roof on a 1,500 Square Foot House?](https://austinsroofing.com/blog/how-much-does-it-cost-to-replace-a-roof/): A one-story 1,500 sq ft house needs roughly 20–22 squares of roofing — a two-story about half that. Here is what that costs in shingles, metal and tile.
- [What Is a Square in Roofing?](https://austinsroofing.com/blog/what-is-a-square-in-roofing/): One roofing square equals 100 square feet. How to measure squares, add pitch and waste, and read a roofing estimate like a contractor.
- [Residential Roofing Warranty Coverage Guide for Homeowners](https://austinsroofing.com/blog/residential-roofing-warranty-coverage-guide-for-homeowners/): Material warranties, workmanship warranties and system warranties — what each one actually covers and the fine print that voids them.
- [Ice and Water Shield Installation Cost Explained](https://austinsroofing.com/blog/ice-and-water-shield-installation-cost/): Self-adhered membrane in valleys and at penetrations, or across the whole deck? What each approach costs and when it is worth it.
- [Attic Ventilation Upgrade Benefits for Long-Term Home Performance](https://austinsroofing.com/blog/attic-ventilation-upgrade-benefits/): Why a balanced intake-and-exhaust system can drop attic temperatures, protect shingles and ease the load on your AC through an Austin summer.
